title: Synopsis planning card: five boxes
subject: English
unit: Summer 2: Time Traveller and Off with Her Head!
source: Written for english/y5 lesson 96 (Synopsis planning card: five boxes (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 96: A one-minute spoken synopsis of our story. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

parts.text: Who and where: Hassan is staying at his Nana's house.
Trigger: one night the hall clock strikes thirteen, and he lands in Tudor London.
Problem: he must reach the tower clock before it strikes again.
Resolution: a baker's boy helps him and Nana's old key takes him home.
Hook to finish: but why does Nana smile the next morning?

keywords.def: a short summary of a story's main events

questions.q: Write your five synopsis boxes as notes
Core: rehearse your synopsis with a partner (breakout room) and time it
Extend: present your synopsis to the class and answer one question
Stretch: give kind, specific feedback to two speakers
questions.a: For example: Your hook made me want to read it.

questions.q: What should a synopsis leave out?
options: small details like what he had for breakfast
questions.a: C) small details like what he had for breakfast. A synopsis keeps only the main events.
